summary: Video-manager initialization that builds three rendering surfaces. For each of S-buffer (256x256), B-buffer (1024x1024) and A-buffer (512x512) it allocates a 96-byte object (OperatorNewNhMallocWrapper + StructInitWithZeroFill), stores it in a dword_7CDE0x global, calls sub_54FEC0 with the buffer's name token and dimensions to configure it, caches a sub-object pointer from object+84 into the companion global, then constructs a texture/object handle via ObjectConstructorWithAllocationAndSubInit. When a construction returns 0, it installs four UV-corner entries via sub_553650 using the screen dimensions from dword_5D6D60/dword_5D6D64. Returns the last constructor result (0 on the A-buffer success path, otherwise the B-buffer constructor result).

operations.description: Allocate a 96-byte surface-descriptor object: v0 = OperatorNewNhMallocWrapper(96); v1 = v0 ? StructInitWithZeroFill(v0) : 0; store v1 into dword_7CDE04.
Configure the S-buffer: sub_54FEC0(aSbuf, 256, 256, 0, 4) using the aSbuf name token and 256x256 dimensions.
Construct the S-buffer texture handle: ObjectConstructorWithAllocationAndSubInit(&dword_7CDE0C, 2, dword_7CDE04, 48, 64).
Allocate the second 96-byte descriptor: v2 = OperatorNewNhMallocWrapper(96); v3 = v2 ? StructInitWithZeroFill(v2) : 0; store v3 into dword_7CDE10.
Configure the B-buffer: sub_54FEC0(aBbuf, 1024, 1024, 0, 4) using the aBbuf name token and 1024x1024 dimensions.
Construct the B-buffer texture handle: ObjectConstructorWithAllocationAndSubInit(&dword_7CDE18, 2, dword_7CDE10, 16, 64).
When the B-buffer constructor returns 0, convert the screen dimensions: v9 = (float)dword_5D6D60, v7 = (float)dword_5D6D64.

Install four UV-corner entries for the B-buffer with sub_553650(index, x, y, 1.0, u, v, 0xFFFFFF) at corners (0,0), (0,height), (width,height), (width,0) using u in {0.0, 0.78125} and v in {0.0, 0.5859375}.
Allocate the third 96-byte descriptor: v4 = OperatorNewNhMallocWrapper(96); v5 = v4 ? StructInitWithZeroFill(v4) : 0; store v5 into dword_7CDE1C.
Configure the A-buffer: sub_54FEC0(aAbuf, 512, 512, 0, 4) using the aAbuf name token and 512x512 dimensions.
Construct the A-buffer texture handle: result = ObjectConstructorWithAllocationAndSubInit(&dword_7CDE24, 2, dword_7CDE1C, 16, 64).
When the A-buffer constructor returns 0, convert the screen dimensions: v8 = (float)dword_5D6D60, v10 = (float)dword_5D6D64.

Install four UV-corner entries for the A-buffer with sub_553650(index, x, y, 1.0, u, v, 0xFFFFFF) at corners (0,0), (0,height), (width,height), (width,0) using u in {0.0, 0.78125} and v in {0.0, 0.5859375}.
Return the last constructor result: on the A-buffer success path the final sub_553650(3, ...) result (nonzero), otherwise the B-buffer/A-buffer ObjectConstructorWithAllocationAndSubInit result.

unresolved: Which surfaces the aAbuf/aBbuf/aSbuf tokens name and the precise meaning of the ObjectConstructorWithAllocationAndSubInit parameters (2, 48/16, 64) are inferred, not confirmed.
The meaning of the object+84 sub-pointer cached into dword_7CDE08/14/20 (likely a D3D surface) is unproven.
dword_8AFE64 is listed in the packet's globals but never appears in the raw function text; its referenced role here is unknown.
The LEGACY ABI lead name 'Render_Surface_Allocation_and_Text_Initializatio' is truncated and not used to name the owner.
Whether sub_553650 writes texture-coordinate data into the surface descriptors or a shared UV table is not established.
